SAVE THE WHALE — KEYS AND TIMING

We checked the tokenized BASIC and a live Fuse 48K start.

At the first prompt, 1 chooses difficult, 2 medium, and 3 easy. We selected 3 and pressed Return. In the active game, the source reads 5 for left, 8 for right, 7 for up, and 6 for down. The kayaks follow the whale after each move.

The replay waits four seconds after tape load, selects difficulty 3, waits three seconds for the board, then holds 5 and 8 for 0.3 seconds each. It takes a screenshot after each move. Emulator speed is set to 100%.

The screenshots show the running board, not a complete escape.
